images.caption: ## 8 Non-Negotiables # Store Presentation ### *Learn how you can make your store shine (literally)!*

Clean glass & floors

  • Maintain sparkly glass, inside and out (particularly on our Fresh rolls displays).

  • There should be no visible food scraps or rubbish in FOH, BOH and dining areas.

## Clean POS & Summary areas - ## These areas should be free of dust, any unnecessary clutter, and packaging. - ## Where we take our customers’ orders should be a reflection of the environment their food is made in.
## Clean dining tables - ## As a team, we aim to clear tables within 2 minutes of customers leaving. - ## The more available seating we have, the more customers we will get.
## Full stocked stations - ## Check products, ingredients as well as cutlery, napkins, condiments, drink fridge, dressing station, etc. - ## Let’s show off our ingredients!
## No labels & handwritten signs in view of customers ## As much as we love our checklists and guides, positioning them out of sight will keep customers focused on our menus and food production.
## Use only black bowls and gastronorms in FOH area. ## Avoid prolonged use of stainless steel and clear plastic tubs at the front - particularly at the rolling station.
## FMG Retail Display ## All FMCG products are fully displayed and uniformed. Labels facing toward customers.
